name: sillon-logo-animation
description: Sillon's animated logo, rendered with Remotion.

scripts.render: remotion render LogoWordmark out/logo-wordmark.mp4 && remotion render LogoSquare out/logo-square.mp4 && remotion render LogoWordmark out/logo-wordmark.gif --codec=gif --every-nth-frame=2 --scale=0.5
